propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked as Work In Progress to prevent accidental submission, since ticket comments and session logs are invisible to submitters but WIP blocks all submissions structurally.

The contribution docs must establish one authoritative rule in CONTRIBUTING.md §2d and mirror it across packaged guides and agent docs, making the WIP hold discoverable by all author types before pushing.

A change author must be able to apply WIP at push time using `%wip` or toggle it post-push via the Gerrit REST endpoint or UI, and unmark it with `%ready` or the ready endpoint once findings are resolved.

The existing code-review guide must surface the WIP rule reachably through the packaged registry mapping so that agent sessions and the `rebar explain review` on-ramp teach the rule without requiring external doc lookup.
The incident of change 1727 (five known defects submitted, breaking main with an unrelated LOC violation) proves the mechanism gap: absence of an enforceable hold mechanism, not discipline failure.
